text: This solution, FP272: Protecting livelihoods and assets at risk from Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs) and climate change-induced flooding in glacial river basins of Nepal addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Nepal between Government of Nepal, Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM), Department of Forests and Soil Conservation (DFSC), Green Climate Fund (GCF), United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD). The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
